name: sparsew2t env build (micromamba, CPU, needs internet)
command: set -e; mkdir -p /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache; cd /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache; if [ ! -x bin/micromamba ]; then curl -Ls https://micro.mamba.pm/api/micromamba/linux-64/latest -o mm.tar.bz2; python3 -c "import tarfile; tarfile.open('mm.tar.bz2').extract('bin/micromamba', '.')"; fi; export MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX=/home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache/mamba PIP_CACHE_DIR=/home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache/pip; ./bin/micromamba create -y -p /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env -f /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/repo/environment.yml > $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/build.log 2>&1; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python -c 'import torch, numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn, yaml, tabulate, baostock; print(torch.__version__)' >> $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/build.log; touch $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/env.ok
